features.name: Datapad baseline
features.note: Live Datapad build: scene sequencer, combat composer, end turn, GM options, initiative tracker, dice settings, paged history.

features.name: Turn Builder 4
features.note: Custom box in every combat category, Secondary activity (not an extra action), deterministic suggestions with an optional play style.

features.name: Taunt (bonus action)
features.note: Owner-ratified contested check: Charisma (Intimidation or Deception) vs Wisdom (Insight); on a win the target has disadvantage against anyone but Aero until his next turn. No forced attack.
